beats.summary: Oscar explains planking as a dangerous and stupid internet trend.

evidence.snippet: Oscar: Planking is a very stupid and dangerous trend. Basically, you lie like a plank in weird places.
Sometimes you get run over. Welcome to the Internet.

beats.summary: Andy announces he is the new manager and appoints Dwight as his enforcer.

evidence.snippet: Andy (drumroll with hands): I… it's unbelievable. True, I may have been the second choice, but I was the first-choice's first choice.
I told him, "I need a really strong number two. I want you to be my enforcer."

beats.summary: Dwight reacts to not getting the manager job by intensifying his physical training and later attacking plankers.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Yeah, at first, I was really disappointed, but I've got a great daily routine going right now.
Dwight (starts attacking plankers): Kids, don't try planking. It's dangerous. 'Specially with me around.

beats.summary: Pam and Jim discuss their pregnancy and the differences from their first child.

evidence.snippet: Pam: Much different the second time around. And I have to say; it is nice not being the only pregnant woman in the office.
Angela: I am having a child with my husband, the Senator. And Pam is having a child with Jim… the great salesman.

beats.summary: Jim and Pam discover a mysterious list in Robert California's notebook dividing staff into two columns.

evidence.snippet: Jim: It's just a list of our names, split into two columns.
Jim: Uh, no, actually. That was in Robert's notebook.
